summary: Three concrete adverse controls confirm that rho guards, proper-trace multiplicity and H27 are essential. The frozen manuscript and inspected implementation retain these requirements. No counterexample to the stated argument was found; the controls refute weakened variants only. Both frozen hashes match.

findings.statement: Removing any of the three tested requirements would invalidate the corresponding intermediate inference.
findings.disposition: The required restrictions remain explicit; the observed controls do not require a manuscript repair.

revisions.action: Ran three bounded independent controls and inspected their source interfaces.
revisions.result: No heavy replay or compiler run; earlier whole-proof coverage limitations remain.

revisions.action: Tested the numerical necessity of the imported H27 value.
revisions.result: Its unreconstructed historical computation and returned-tree limitation remain material disclosed assurance limits.

checks.scope: Failure from broadening the rho classification or support reduction
checks.method: Independently reproduce Alpha's round3 literal control; compare manuscript Sections5.2–6 and LOW15-R15-rho7-classification.md.
checks.observation: P10 minus012,015 together with H7={023,024,034,124,134,015,016} shifted by6 has15 members, support13 and rho8. All455 triples of members are sunflower-free. It refutes both an unrestricted eleven-point support bound and an R16-minus-one classification through rho8. The manuscript instead derives support11 under rho<=6, classifies exact rho7, and separately treats rho8. Neither invalid extension is used.

checks.scope: Failure from making proper traces binary
checks.method: Construct a literal SF4 control and inspect D19-model-bridge.md Section2 plus degree19_projection_v5.py build bounds.
checks.observation: Lift P10 plus a disjoint P9 through99, then add {0,6,7,100} and {0,6,7,101}. The21-member family has complete root degree19 and zero sunflowers among1330 member triples, but two completions of core trace067. Thus local sunflower and complete-link restrictions do not justify binary proper traces. The implementation assigns triple traces upper2 and four-traces upper1, matching the bridge. This small control is not a size68 model counterexample.

checks.scope: Failure of fibre positivity after weakening H27
checks.method: Independently reproduce Alpha's round5 weighted A3 control, checking all256 image supports and the direct-Jin positivity order.
checks.observation: Masses (0,15,13,0,12,0,15,13) give a triangle-free complete blowup of order68, minimum actual degree25 and independence number28, with three empty fibres. Adjacent masses are (12,27,28,28,28,28,28,25). Hence order and minimum degree do not supply positivity without the exact independence cap27. The source proves positivity from H27 before using occupied-fibre lower bounds. This graph control does not claim representation by a sunflower-free family.
